name: Shu Li Fei
source:
Fei, the adopted daughter of a Hong Kong Triad leader, was raised with an education befitting a young woman of privilege. This upbringing has instilled in her a cool, composed exterior, though beneath this facade lies warmth and gentleness. Like any young woman, she also harbors a touch of dreamy idealism, a yearning for something beyond the world she was born into.

Her father is the man who brought "Takeo" into the underworld eighteen years ago and subsequently raised him as an assassin. While Fei has only a vague understanding of the true nature of her father's profession, she nonetheless holds him in deep respect.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://clockup.net/yrg/#character]official website[/url]]
